Orbit and Figure-Eight Through Two Flows

The same sketch through three flows: the pin-trained xswap reading it from the source, SDEdit initialising the unpinned scratch3 from the sketch chunk at t0 = 0.3, and the unpinned scratch3 with the sketch injected into its source (no training-time constraint). Five trials each. Tables give each flight's closest approach to a gate post; the route judge does not apply to these motion programs.
